notes.claim: The four quadrants let coordinates with negative and positive values be plotted.
Open Up Resources says the signs of a point's coordinates tell you which quadrant it is in.
Nelson MathLinks tells the learner that if the x-coordinate is 0 they do not count left or right, so the point sits on an axis.
A research article lists failing to tell the axes apart and wrongly assigning points to the axes or quadrants among common errors,

sources.title: Grade 6 Math Unit 7 Section C Lesson 14 — Student Edition
sources.quote: We can always tell which quadrant a point is located in by the signs of its coordinates.

sources.title: Coordinates and Design
sources.quote: If the x -coordinate is 0, do not count left or right.

sources.title: Research Article The Most Common Conceptual Errors in
